lead_independence.headline: Buc-ee's at I-95 and Indrio Road clears county review, awaits state sign-off
lead_independence.lead: The proposed Buc-ee's at Interstate 95 and Indrio Road has completed St. Lucie County's planning process and is now waiting on final approvals from the Florida Department of Transportation and the Florida Department of Environmental Protection before construction can begin. The 76,000-square-foot travel center would include approximately 120 fuel pumps and could become the largest Buc-ee's location in Florida. Buc-ee's has previously targeted a 2028 opening date.
